text:
alyssa: spotted a small cluster of tenants with doubled lines in invoice PREVIEW around 03:12 UTC. final invoices are deduped but support is getting tickets. putting it here to coordinate.

sam: traced to ingest ordering. we emit a provisional metering event with epoch=null, then the joiner commits epoch a moment later -> preview shows both until dedupe runs. example:
```
2026-03-22T03:12:01Z INFO ingest req=ri_x12 epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=142
2026-03-22T03:12:02Z INFO joiner req=ri_x12 epoch=ep-20260322-03 tokens=142
```
mira: that explains it. users see two preview rows and panic even though canonical ledger later dedupes. quick mitigation ideas?
jordan: short-term: console-side collapse that groups preview rows when a matching final commit appears within 5m. show a tiny "provisional" badge and allow expand for audit. low-risk and reversible.

alyssa: medium-term we should fix at source. options?
sam: (A) edge-proxy can wait a small per-route window (20-100ms) for epoch assignment before emitting provisional (feature-flagged). (B) standardize x-client-request-id in SDKs so retries don't generate new request_ids that break dedupe. add telemetry counters: metering.provisional_emitted, metering.provisional_wait_ms, metering.preview_duplicate_count.
jordan: alternative approach: shadow-preview stream + Redis/Lua dedupe store. Shadow mode lets us trial suppression without affecting users. Dedupe key should consider (request_id, client_request_id, provisional_epoch||epoch, stream_session_id for streaming).
mira: console UX: add a route toggle "Billing-consistent mode" with copy: "Small increase in median latency (~5-25ms) for fewer duplicate preview rows and steadier invoice previews." also add an audit-only toggle so support can see raw provisional lines.

ops-bot: INC-4821 suppressed alerts for affected cohort while we triage.

sam: owners: I'll PR edge change behind feature flag ingest.bump/provisional_epoch and add the telemetry.
jordan: I'll build shadow-preview consumer, Redis Lua dedupe, and e2e tests that reorder join/ingest to assert single preview row.
mira: I'll own console collapse + modal copy and the support audit toggle.

alyssa: timeline: console quick collapse today as opt-in for support. infra changes feature-flagged in ~48h. canary 5% tenants -> ramp over 7 days if metrics look good. Ops hold alerts during canary. Reconvene 11:00 PT with PR links. If you see another preview spike, tag me with raw log lines and request_id. :thumbsup:
